hooks.command: bash -c 'for cli in "$HOME/.local/bin/throne-cli" "$HOME/bin/throne-cli"; do [ -x "$cli" ] && exec "$cli" throne-startup; done; command -v throne-cli >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec throne-cli throne-startup; exec "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}/bin/throne-cli" throne-startup'

bash -c 'for cli in "$HOME/.local/bin/throne-cli" "$HOME/bin/throne-cli"; do [ -x "$cli" ] && { "$cli" skill-extension --hook 2>/dev/null; exit 0; }; done; command -v throne-cli >/dev/null 2>&1 && { throne-cli skill-extension --hook 2>/dev/null; exit 0; }; "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}/bin/throne-cli" skill-extension --hook 2>/dev/null; exit 0'
